posture.name: head_trunk_angle_HTA
posture.definition: angle between the ear-eye line and the trunk notochord line (K95)

series.note: trend estimate; two reads of the ZFIN page returned 55

posture.name: axis_wrap_angle_on_yolk
posture.definition: arc of the yolk sphere followed by the body axis, measured at the yolk center; null once the tail is free

series.note: tail lifts from the yolk; yolk extension separates

posture.name: axis_length_on_yolk
posture.definition: length of the body axis during segmentation, longer than EL because of curvature

posture.name: tail_free_of_yolk
posture.definition: true once the tail bud has lifted from the yolk

series.note: 20-25 somite stage, EL jumps to 1.4 mm

notes.conventions: hpf at 28.5 C; dpf x 24 = hpf. EL is the greatest linear dimension of the unstraightened embryo (K95). SL is snout to caudal fin base. TL includes the caudal fin.
notes.estimate_flag: estimate=true marks values read from images or derived from sourced ratios; replace when a measurement appears. Notes containing 'unverified' mark values taken from search summaries of papers I could not open.
